profile.summary: Hello! I am a 4th year first-generation college student studying CS at the University of California, Santa Cruz. I have a strong interest in back-end development, specifically infrastructure and distributed systems! I have previous software development experience at Google, Amazon and Apple. I hope to continue expanding my technical knowledge through more experiences.
